Bitcoin was flat near $76,562 in early Asian trade. Crypto Reca independently shows no real order; AVAX is PREPARE/WATCH, so intelligence remains contextual and creates neither a buy nor a sell signal.

items.headline: Hawkish Fed lifts dollar to seven-week high as markets reprice tightening path
items.summary: Reuters reports the dollar index reached its strongest level since July 31 as short-term U.S. yields rose after the Fed hike and guidance for more tightening. Bitcoin was flat around $76,562 in early Asian trading.
items.whyItMatters: A stronger dollar and higher front-end yields are direct transmission channels from tighter Fed policy into less favorable liquidity conditions for crypto risk assets.
items.actionReason: Confirmed post-FOMC tightening transmission is material but does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: Warsh says inflation remains too high and underlying trends have not meaningfully improved
items.summary: Reuters reports Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation remains too high and persistent and that summer data have not shown meaningful improvement in underlying inflation trends. He also said the U.S. economy has strengthened and the labor market is at or near full employment.
items.whyItMatters: Hawkish post-hike guidance supports the risk of further tightening, higher real yields and a stronger dollar, all of which can constrain crypto liquidity.
items.actionReason: The scheduled press-conference event has resolved, but confirmed hawkish guidance keeps macro volatility risk elevated.

items.headline: Federal Reserve raises target rate 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%
items.summary: Reuters confirms the Federal Reserve raised its key interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4.00%, the first increase in more than three years. The decision was unanimous and the Fed indicated more tightening is likely in the near future.
items.whyItMatters: A renewed Fed tightening cycle can lift real yields and the dollar and reduce risk-asset liquidity.
items.actionReason: The decision and press conference are resolved, but the Fed has signaled likely further tightening. This is not an independent sell instruction.

items.headline: Dollar and yields remain restrictive around Fed decision
items.summary: Reuters reported the dollar near a two-week high before the decision, with markets heavily pricing a quarter-point hike and further tightening. Global markets remained sensitive to the near-5% U.S. 10-year yield and oil above $100.
items.whyItMatters: High yields and a firm dollar tighten financial conditions for crypto and other risk assets.
items.actionReason: Restrictive macro conditions remain material but do not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: U.S. Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
items.summary: The Senate procedural vote failed 49-50, short of the 60 votes required to advance the digital-asset market-structure bill. The failure extended U.S. regulatory uncertainty and was followed by material weakness across crypto, especially XRP.
items.whyItMatters: Failure to advance the bill removes a near-term path to broader U.S. market-structure clarity and can sustain a regulatory risk premium.
items.actionReason: The event is resolved and negative but is not a direct protocol failure and does not independently trigger a sale.

items.headline: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield crosses 5%, highest since 2023
items.summary: Reuters reported the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield above 5% amid renewed inflation concerns, oil-price pressure and expectations of restrictive Fed policy.
items.whyItMatters: A 5% 10-year yield raises the opportunity cost of holding risk assets and can pressure crypto liquidity and valuations.
items.actionReason: Material tightening in financial conditions, not an independent sell instruction.

catalysts.headline: Bank of Japan policy decision expected to raise rate to 1.25%
catalysts.summary: Reuters reports the Bank of Japan is expected to raise rates to 1.25%, a 31-year high, as inflation risks persist. The exact decision time was not verified in this run, so the less-than-24-hour and less-than-6-hour rules are not applied yet.
catalysts.whyItMatters: Further Japanese tightening can affect global yields, yen carry trades and risk-asset liquidity.
catalysts.actionReason: Reliable HIGH catalyst inside seven days, but exact decision time was not verified, so no shorter-window escalation is inferred.
